name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
short: Google's Pro flagship (2M/64K) for research/multimodal agents; ARC-AGI-2 77.1% and GPQA 94.3%.
modalities: Text, image, audio, video, PDF in; text out
freeTierNote: Free tier available on Google AI Studio and OpenCode Zen
standout: The long-memory specialist: a 2M-token window plus unusually strong abstract-reasoning puzzle skill makes it Google’s pick for whole-repository analysis and research-grade multimodal agents.
tradeoff: Pro-lane pricing with a comparatively modest output cap — you pay flagship rates for a slower model that earns its keep only where the huge input window matters.
